answer: Each new agent must pass a 3-stage ramp: an oasis stake of 15 POA, then 4 weekly quotas that raise its trust ceiling from 100 to 400 tasks. Faking N identities means N stakes and N quotas, so 1,000 fakes cost 15,000 POA locked plus 4,000 quota runs, while an honest user pays 15 once. Auditors replay 8% of completed tasks; an umber flag on output copied between accounts burns 75% of that stake and freezes the whole trellis of linked wallets for 60 days, so clones lose money faster than they earn.
